mobbin:024a7f32-0ecc-4767-9123-0fb0830f2.summary: Event host opens Scan to Check In, points the phone camera at a guest ticket QR, confirms the guest card (name/email/Going), taps Check In, then returns to the scanner with a Guest checked in toast.
steps: Host scanner — point at ticket QR
steal: Explicit copy: Point the camera at a ticket QR code (steps 0, 2) — makes scanner role unambiguous.
Guest confirmation sheet before commit (step 1) — name/email/status then Check In.
Transient Guest checked in banner while scanner stays open (step 2) — queue throughput.
List vs Scan toggle + search escape hatch (steps 0, 2).
avoid: Host scanning guest tickets as the model for room-TV feedback QR — inverts who holds the code.
mobbin:024a7f32-0ecc-4767-9123-0fb0830f2.fit: Counter to Essentials checklist-qr (learner/phone reads TV QR without login); only weak adjacent for staff verifying attendance at the door.
